//! One-request observer for the two authored compiler differential profiles.

mod compiler_fixture_observer {
    pub mod observe;
    pub mod options;
    pub mod profile;
}

use compiler_fixture_observer::{observe, profile::Request};
use std::io::{self, Read, Write};

const MAX_REQUEST_BYTES: u64 = 2 * 1024 * 1024;

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let mut input = Vec::new();
    io::stdin()
        .take(MAX_REQUEST_BYTES + 1)
        .read_to_end(&mut input)?;
    if input.len() as u64 > MAX_REQUEST_BYTES {
        return Err("compiler observer request exceeds 2 MiB".into());
    }
    let request: Request = serde_json::from_slice(&input)?;
    let observation = observe::run(request)?;
    let stdout = io::stdout();
    let mut output = stdout.lock();
    serde_json::to_writer(&mut output, &observation)?;
    output.write_all(b"\n")?;
    Ok(())
}
